question: As per the Consumer Protection Act 2019, an e-commerce entity is a company incorporated as per the Indian Companies Act and it will appoint a ________ to ensure compliance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**nodal officer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An e-commerce unit refers to a company that conducts business online, selling products or services through a website or mobile application. **
 
• According to the **Consumer Protection Act 2019,** an e-commerce unit is a corporation under the **Indian Companies Act,** and it will appoint a nodal officer to ensure compliance. 
 
• The nodal officer will be responsible for** addressing consumer complaints,** ensuring timely refunds, and overseeing the company's compliance with the Act's provisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adhiniyam** means "**Act**" in Hindi.
 
• **Kanishth karmachari **means "**junior employee**" in Hindi.
 
• **Sulah adhikari **means "**conciliation officer**" in Hindi.
 
• **Nodal adhikari **means "**nodal officer**" in Hindi.
